preservedResponsibilities: Native deferred HTMLAttr item clones, raw content offsets, actual SwNodeIndex endpoints, copy/Reset/SetStart and open/previous chains. Stable mutable tuples represent borrowed HTMLAttr** slots; the original table field order and retained shared table identity are preserved. OSL_ENSURE diagnostics do not become new runtime failures.

Native NewAttr chain admission, DeleteAttr middle/head correction and pending-queue preservation, and SaveAttrTab original field-order traversal and open-head/table rebinding. Split helpers borrow the actual SwHTMLParser fields through a structural interface; they do not reconstruct state.
omittedResponsibilities: EndAttr/SetAttr_ application, full HTMLReader dispatch and compiled native behavior are still pending; JavaScript garbage collection replaces native item/table deallocation.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Deferred attribute owners are split from the large native SwHTMLParser implementation while preserving their source fields, item and chain ownership.
